title.zh: 将黎刹省罗德里格斯市镇圣拉斐尔描笼涯的Wawa公路命名为Licerio I. Geronimo将军公路的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Wawa Road At Barangay San Rafael, Municipality of Rodriguez, Province of Rizal as General Licerio I. Geronimo Highway
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Wawa Road At Barangay San Rafael, Municipality of Rodriguez, Province of Rizal as General Licerio I. Geronimo Highway

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2018/ra_11044_2018.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Wawa Road at Barangay San Rafael, Municipality of Rodriguez Province of Rizal, an extension of San Mateo-Rodriguez National Secondary Road shall be known and renamed as General Licerio I. Gernimo Highway.

The Department of Public Works and Highways shall place appropriate markers along the General Licerio I. Geronimo Highway and shall issue the necessary rules, orders and circulars to implement this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication two (2) national newspapers of general circulation.
